analysis_steps.goal: extract disk-integrated spectra and identify lines

method.value: Integrate cubes in circular region radius 1.1''; assign with Splatalogue, CDMS, JPL

evidence.quote: integrating the reduced ALMA data cubes within a circular region of radius $1.1''$ from the center of Titan

validation.value: Features detected at >3 sigma; spectra uncrowded

evidence.quote: The spectra are sufficiently uncrowded that unambiguous assignments were possible for all detected lines.

method.value: Sum strongest lines per species (six C2H5CN lines 223.9-224.1 GHz) and overlay on continuum

evidence.quote: the strongest six lines in the range 223.9-224.1 GHz (shown in Fig. 3(b)) were summed to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the map

method.value: Line-by-line radiative transfer least-squares fits of step and gradient abundance profiles to 223.9-224.2 GHz lines

evidence.quote: least-squares fits to the observed spectra were performed using C$_2$H$_5$CN abundance profiles with constant mixing ratio above a specified cutoff altitude $z_c$ and zero abundance below.

key_parameters.value: step z_c 100-400 km; gradient model reference altitude 292 km, slope as fraction of scale height

evidence.quote: The free parameters in this model were the abundance at a reference altitude $z_r = 292$ km

assumptions.value: Profiles do not vary with latitude/longitude; Lorentzian half-width 0.075 cm-1 atm-1 at 296 K, exponent 0.50; model atmosphere to 1000 km

evidence.quote: The Lorentzian broadening half-width at 296 K was assumed to be 0.075 cm$^{-1}$ atm$^{-1}$, with a temperature-dependence exponent of 0.50.

findings_qualitative.value: C2H5CN emission is concentrated in the southern hemisphere whereas other species peak in the north

evidence.quote: the emission from C$_2$H$_5$CN is found to be concentrated in the southern (autumn) hemisphere

claims.hypothesis: Gas-phase C2H5CN is present in Titan's atmosphere
claims.result: 27 lines in 19 features detected at >3 sigma

evidence.quote: the detection of 27 rotational lines from C$_2$H$_5$CN (in 19 separate emission features detected at $>3\sigma$ confidence)

claims.hypothesis: C2H5CN is located at high altitude
claims.experiment: Radiative transfer fits with step and gradient profiles
claims.result: Good fits for z_c 300/400 km and gradient; poor for 100 km

evidence.quote: Radiative transfer models show that C$_2$H$_5$CN is most concentrated at altitudes $\gtrsim200$ km

claims.hypothesis: C2H5CN spatial distribution differs from other nitriles

evidence.quote: a significant ($7\sigma$) flux enhancement over the southern pole relative to the north

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Temperature variation as the cause of asymmetry judged unlikely

evidence.quote: so spatial variations in the gas temperature are an unlikely explanation for the observed asymmetries

limitations_admitted.value: No temperature information for the epoch; further work needed
